item.title: Three ways new Apple products next week will modernize iPhone, iPad, and Mac
item.description: Apple officially confirmed that it will begin launching new products starting on Monday, March 2. With new iPhones, iPads, and Macs, Apple will modernize its hardware lineup in three ways by saying goodbye to some old technology decisions. more…

item.title: Eddy Cue says Brazil is Apple TV’s second-largest market, talks Netflix-Warner merger, more
item.description: In an interview with Brazilian newspaper Folha de S. Paulo, Cue emphasized Brazil’s growing role in Apple TV’s global business, reaffirmed the company’s commitment to theatrical releases, and commented on Netflix’s attempt to acquire Warner Bros. Here are the details. more…

item.title: iPhone could benefit from memory chip crisis in one key way: report
item.description: A new Bloomberg report covering IDC data offers a dire outlook for the smartphone market in 2026 due to the current memory chip crisis, but Apple and the iPhone could actually benefit in one key way. more…

item.title: iOS 26’s Apple Maps feature can save you from traffic, here’s how to set it up
item.description: iOS 26 brought several solid upgrades to Apple Maps, including a feature centered on your typical routes and patterns that might save you from unexpected traffic delays. more…

item.title: New book explores Steve Jobs’ NeXT years and the road to his Apple comeback
item.description: In the upcoming book “Steve Jobs in Exile,” author Geoffrey Cain will explore the lesser-told story of the years that preceded, and ultimately prepared, Steve Jobs for his historic return to Apple. Here are the details. more…

item.title: visionOS 26.3.1 now available with Apple TV app fix
item.description: Apple has released visionOS 26.3.1 for Apple Vision Pro users today. The update fixes a flickering problem in the Apple TV app, according to the release notes. more…

item.title: Netflix drops bid to buy HBO, Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Netflix won’t be the new owners of Warner Bros. Discovery after all. Back in December, the company beat out Paramount with a huge $83 billion deal to acquire WBD, but today the company dropped its bid. more…

item.title: Apple asks court to dismiss proposed class action over Siri AI fraud claims
item.description: The lawsuit accuses Apple of having misled investors about the timeline and readiness of its Apple Intelligence and Siri features, as well as in relation to the Epic Games case. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters season 2 now available on Apple TV
